visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, dark, wavy hair, a black knitted sweater, and a pearl necklace sits in a brightly lit studio setting with a clean white background. She speaks directly to the camera with a subtle smile and gentle hand movements. (2) A close-up shot features a light green, square-shaped cosmetic compact (cushion) held in her hands. The 'LANEIGE' logo is visible on its lid. (3) The scene shifts to a medium-up shot as she applies the cosmetic product to her forearm using a light green applicator puff, demonstrating the texture on her skin. (4) The woman is shown applying the cushion to her face, specifically on her cheek and nose area; her skin has some minor redness and spots that are gradually covered. (5) A split-screen comparison appears, labeled 'Before' and 'After', showing one side of her face with product applied and the other side without. (6) In a night setting, the woman is seen in a handheld selfie video at an outdoor stadium. Bright purple and neon lights illuminate the scene, with a blurred crowd in the background. (7) Three young men in stylish, casual performance outfits are seen dancing on a stage under bright stadium lights; the crowd in the foreground is visible as silhouettes holding lightsticks. (8) The woman returns to the studio setting, holding the green compact near her face while speaking, concluding the video with a cheerful expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A medium-tempo, upbeat electronic pop track begins. A young woman's clear, friendly Mandarin narration is layered over the music. Short, high-pitched 'pop' and 'whoosh' digital sound effects punctuate the transitions between cosmetic descriptions. (2) The acoustic texture shifts as a faint wind noise and outdoor environmental floor enter the mix, accompanying the narrator's description of traveling to Kaohsiung. (3) A loud burst of stadium audio occurs, featuring heavy synth beats and rhythmic electronic percussion, followed by distinct crowd cheering and screaming at a high arousal level. (4) The audio returns to the studio narration style; the BGM maintains a steady, bright spectral quality as the narrator provides a final summary and recommendation for the makeup product.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Intro -> Feature Demonstration -> Real-world Wear Test -> Conclusion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Laneige's Neo Cushion and powder products by demonstrating their effectiveness and durability. It uses the extreme scenario of attending an outdoor concert in hot, humid weather ('Kaohsiung') to prove that the makeup remains intact and attractive even after 13 hours of wear.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator provides detailed product names, uses brand hashtags (#小方塊氣墊), and demonstrates application while giving a positive recommendation.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines professional studio-style review elements with high-energy vlog footage to build authenticity and trust in the product's performance.
